== Biography ==
William was born in 1831. He is the son of [[Glasgow-3463|John Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-719723|Mary Unknown]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3463]] is assessed at 94% (proved). The held 1851 MyHeritage census extract names William among James’s siblings and gives John and Mary as parents. William’s 1831 Ayrshire birth fits the older-son slot and the later Gateside family, supporting the same John father.

Held MyHeritage census-index extract with the named family relationships; underlying census image was not newly inspected.

Next useful test: Read William’s own 1851 relationship column and a baptism.

Source basis already held: [https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-10980-465673/james-glasgow-in-1851-scotland-census 1851 Scotland Census, James Glasgow household of John Glasgow, Gateside, Beith]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
